definitions.explanation: A suffix added to nouns to indicate that something comes with or includes the stated feature. Extremely productive in product descriptions, real estate listings, restaurant menus, and everyday speech.
Used after a time period or unit to mean 'per' or 'for each,' expressing a rate or frequency.

examples.japanese: {朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I booked a hotel with breakfast included.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧{付|つ}きです。
examples.english: This room comes with air conditioning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧{付|つ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかなかない→なかなかない：27254_nakanakanai⟧です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a property with a parking space, but there aren't many in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{付|つ}き⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧だ。
⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{付|つ}き{五万円|ごまんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧だ。
examples.english: The rent is 50,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧{付|つ}き⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: This plan includes thirty minutes of free consultation per session.

notes:
From the verb ⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (to attach, to be included). As a suffix, it is one of the most frequently encountered functional elements in everyday Japanese — seen on menus, in real estate ads, on product packaging, and in spoken language.

USAGE:
Sense 1 attaches directly to nouns: {朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}き (with breakfast), ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧{付|つ}き (with a bath), ⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧{付|つ}き (with a guarantee). This pattern is extremely productive and can be applied to almost any noun.

Sense 2 follows counters or time units: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{付|つ}き (per person), ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{付|つ}き (per day).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}き: with breakfast included
- ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧{税|ぜい}{込|こ}み{付|つ}き: with shipping and tax included
- ⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧{付|つ}き: with a guarantee
- ⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧{付|つ}き: furnished
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{付|つ}き: per person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: included — often used for prices ({税込|ぜいこ}み, {送料込|そうりょうこ}み)
- {入|い}り: containing — for ingredients or contents ({砂糖入|さとうい}り, {氷入|こおりい}り)
- あたり: per — more colloquial alternative for sense 2 (⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧あたり)
